candidates.title: Desktop Pet Direct Controls Tutorial Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive controls screen right before completion to teach users how to summon, move, and hide their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received 3 separate emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.

new_controls_tutorial.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_controls_tutorial.body: Quick key shortcuts to easily summon, move, and hide your pet anytime on your screen.

components.text: Press Alt+P to show or hide your desktop pet
Right-click pet anytime for interaction menu & settings

guard.reason: Adds a valid tutorial screen inside onboarding without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has the highest drop rate (35.2%) and strong support evidence, but building a new screen is high cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Choice Grid Path Selection
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a visual choice card grid to help users quickly decide between template and custom pets.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s and drop-off rate of nearly 24%.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Companion?
choose_path.body: Choose a pre-made pet companion or craft a custom friend from your own photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path while retaining both adopting and custom photo options.

candidates.score_note: Redesigning choose_path helps with the long 514s mean time, though only backed by funnel metrics.

candidates.title: Multi-Photo Mascot Verification Flow
candidates.change: Replaces standard photo upload with a guided multi-photo picker with mascot quality feedback before generating the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong, and adoption step drop-off reaches 30.4%.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Provide 1-3 well-lit photos facing forward so we can render your pet accurately.

photo_upload.text: Photos uploaded will be checked for clear faces and lighting.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a mascot cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Split Layout Sign-In with Existing Account Safeguard
candidates.change: Redesigns sign-in screen into a split layout separating existing pet account recovery from new account creation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained that pets were missing or reset after signing in again, making it the top support topic.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Log in with your existing account to restore saved pets or create a new account.

sign_in_options.text: Existing user? Sign in with original method to recover pets.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Estimated Render Progress Timer Screen
candidates.change: Displays an explicit completion time estimate and live progress indicator on the waiting screen while rendering pet assets.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing high user drop-off.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Life
waiting.body: We are compiling 3D models and desktop animations for your companion.

guard.reason: text in 'waiting.components[0].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['~']

candidates.title: Desktop Display Diagnostic Hint Callout
candidates.change: Adds a persistent diagnostic tip callout on the home intro screen explaining what to do if the pet is hidden or off-screen.
candidates.why: 3 users wrote support saying their pet did not show on the desktop or the app failed to open after completing onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Can't see your pet on screen? Check your taskbar overflow tray or press Alt+P.

components.text: Tip: If your pet isn't visible on desktop, click its tray icon to bring it to the front.

guard.reason: Adds a diagnostic hint callout on the home intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets the high drop finish step with direct support mail evidence and simple config/hint cost.

candidates.title: Welcome Bonus Accessory Badge Prompt
candidates.change: Offers an immediate unlockable starter accessory badge on the final onboarding screen to increase completion motivation.
candidates.why: The finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with an overall onboarding completion rate of only 21.4%.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Brought a Welcome Gift!
home_intro.body: Finish setup now to unlock a free starter toy accessory for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions gifts and free extras.

candidates.title: Interactive Story Screen Onboarding Preview
candidates.change: Updates story screen copy and button labels to clearly state that full onboarding takes under 2 minutes.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a high mean duration (514s) suggesting initial user hesitation.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion in 2 Minutes
story.body: Bring a charming virtual pet directly onto your desktop to keep you company while working or gaming.

guard.reason: Updates story screen copy while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Quick copy change addressing choose_path hesitation (514s mean duration), but lower overall impact.

candidates.title: Certificate Naming and Identity Guidance
candidates.change: Adds an explicit hint and styled pet name input on the adoption certificate screen to make pet naming fun and memorable.
candidates.why: Adoption stage conversion sits at 69.6% with a median duration of 89s.

adoption_certificate.hint: Choose a memorable name! You can edit your pet's name anytime in settings.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Friend Selection
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in screen to occur right after pet selection instead of before choosing a path.
candidates.why: Forcing sign in early before users build attachment to a pet reduces funnel conversion across first-run steps.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step to occur after pet selection, which is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in reduces early drop-off (23.4% drop) by building attachment first.

picked: Desktop Pet Direct Controls Tutorial Screen
